content: Yaq no tæqeív ndǿgo: Ndego qonam nonqo-te go꞉qotam, teqa nakeamo zenda-te, pepa løvøyat ndøndapám. Ta pepa løvøyat ndøgo, peawap yaqyaq-ús neka ndøgo gètokám. Ndavánd qane-tokeapám. Sevén ate gi꞉goam.
Yaq no enzol ezoqam bazaføgakh-qape no-omét. Kandambaqapé møndæ-akhá. Āv gene-akhá nqǽgo, “Gekha ezoqâm ndego, ezoqa eqeieqei, nginik ndavand tekoqogim neka pepa løvøyat vǿ-mboqoā?”
Geté ezoqam mbaín, yan-te nqo꞉go o manqei-qape-te nqanek o manqei mokho-te nqøugu, ndego kopømba ndøgo, pepa løvøyat temboqoa neka manqat vǿqeīv, mokho-te ndøu-peawap.
Yaq no nø̀vín. Eiv baza mø̀ndønøpós, qæ-eivat. Zapa ndǿgo, ezoqa eqeieqei kopo mbaín, ndego pepa løvøyat peawap-us temboqoa, mokho-te ndøugu vǿe-qeīv.

Geté megetapak ezoqa kopo, āv genømbe-eín nqǽgo, “Ndò-ei᷄v. Nqáe! Ezoqa kopo ndêgó. Ezoqa ndégo, ndego Saitan getømbuiu. Ndego andé Layón. Zuda khagua bawan mokho-té gunu꞉gú. Deivid-gé zeó. Ndego kopømbaqapé, ndavand seven tekoqogim neka pepa løvøyat vǿ-mboqoā.

Yaq livin-mba ndøugu, ma qonam nonqo qægoam, no Sip Nakhasam no-omét. Khandi gigiap neka megetapak, ùnime꞉-ogitavát. Sip Nakhasam ndego, løvøwe bugug ndøkewagám. Teqa kawa-te, ndego auli seven mbogoám, neka bøi seven vømbōgoam. Bøi seven ndøgo, Mbumbukiam-gí nqova sevén. Ndigu nqova ndígu, Mbumbukiam manqei-manqei ate nqægo gekhofosam.
Yaq ndego Sip Nakhasam, tenøwáv ndǿgo, pepa løvøyat, teqa nakeamo zenda-te vø̄ndap, ndego kawa ezoqam-qa qonam nonqo-te go꞉qotam.

Yaq ndego pepa løvøyat gendap, ndigu khandi gigiap foa neka megetapak tuenti-foa, teqa megemege-te ndo꞉go, ekeza kha, manqei me꞉laém. Nginik ezoqa kopokopo ate gi꞉goam, ouv qaqaeam nonqo, mø̀ndøzø-goám, ande gitá, neka gol ndis vøzø̄goam. Ta gol ndis-te ndøugu, gigiap sisip mbomømboma ndømboqotupát. Khøifa sisip mbomømboma, qando-fakhatam, ndøgo Mbumbukiam-gí ezoqam-qá guliguli manqát.
Yaq ndigu ouv ndakinak ndøqaqaemám. Sip Nakhasam-té. Ouv āv gimbøe-qaqaemám nqǽgo:

content.text: Qo kopømbaqapé, nqanek pepa løvøyat toqondap neka ndavand nditøkebap, voqó-koqogīm.
Zapa ndǿgo, qo qakeza kha qonqonqotáv, vø̄laqabem,

content: Yaq no enzol ezoqam nøzømét, neka tiqa manqa wag vø̄e-ewag. Enzol ezoqam kopoav-qapé. Taosen-taosen ndøgoám. Gevebumav-qapé. Nginik enzol ezoqam, qonam nonqo neka khandi gigiap foa neka megetapak, ùnime꞉-khøogavát.
Ndigu ouv ndøqaqaemám. Gèzømbo-eqavát. Ouv āv gini-qaqaemám nqǽgo,

content.text: bazaføgakh neka gigiap ate ndægo neka matavap loloakh neka megeat matev neka vizap matev neka iz eqawat matev neka khanakhanakh manqat, teqa ndégo tabegó.

content: Yaq tæ-ewág ndǿgo: Gigiap ate ndi꞉gu, yan-te ngo꞉go neka manqei-qape-te ngigu neka manqei-qape mokho-te ngu꞉gu neka ndaola-te ngigu, ouv ndøqaqaemám. Āv gini-qaqaemám nqǽgo,

content.text: neka Sip Nakhasam, khanakhanakh manqat neka vizap matev neka iz eqawat matev neka bazaføgakh tiqá.

content: Yaq ndigu khandi gigiap foa gindu-qavøinam, “Amén. Nqanek manqat unimanqatín.” Yaq ndigu megetapak, ekeza kha, manqei me꞉laém, Mbumbukiam, Sip Nakhasam namba, vøzø̄vizam.
